svg.aria-label: Animated terminal: whoami prints Brejesh Balakrishnan, AI Engineer at Cloud202, working on governance and safety for agentic AI on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore. about.yml lists his focus on tool-using agents, guard models, RAG and evals; about two years full-stack at Accenture; B.E. ECE from College of Engineering Guindy; languages Tamil, Malayalam, English and Python. agent-govbench summary: attack success 51.5% with no guard, 4.7% with the LLM guard, 0.4% of legitimate calls blocked.
